description: This file contains shell commands that automate git operations, notably testing different push scenarios such as normal push, atomic push, non-fast-forward push, forced push, and cleanup operations, utilizing test frameworks and command outputs for validation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the included commands, with validation of output against expected results.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure of the enclosed commands, used to validate error handling.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats command output into a stable, user-friendly format for validation.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves expected command output for later comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares reference outputs of git refs between local and upstream repositories.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters out non-essential parts of output for comparison.
